html:
Cu Lao Cham Tourism will take visitors to the island sea trade route, which has been recognized by UNESCO as a world biosphere reserve. Coming here, visitors can not only visit but also experience exciting island games.

Cu Lao Cham is located 18km from Cua Dai beach, and is recognized by UNESCO as a world biosphere reserve, where there is a rich and diverse flora and fauna, and many famous landscapes.

Cu Lao Cham includes 8 small islands such as: Hon Lao Island (also known as Hon Cu Lao, the largest), Hon Kho Me, Hon Kho Con, Hon La, Hon Dai, Hon Mo, Hon Tai, Hon Ong..

If you are planning to travel to Da Nang, visit Cu Lao Cham and experience a canoe to visit the islands, visitors will feel the unique beauty that this place brings to visitors.

Cu Lao Cham Island is located on the route of Bach Ma – Hai Van – Son Tra, coming here visitors will admire the poetic beauty, and experience fishing or diving to see coral.

Cu Lao Cham, where the climate is cool all year round, is an indispensable destination in the Da Nang tour itinerary. Coming here, visitors can also visit famous scenic spots, especially the experience of walking on the seabed of Cu Lao Cham, discovering the beauty of the ocean floor.

Experience walking on the seabed of Cu Loa Hello, you don’t need to know how to swim, and still discover the beauty of the seabed, you will be guided and wear a helmet and flippers to explore the beauty with the school of fish swimming around.

Come to Cu Loa Cham with Vietlook Travel today to experience the most interesting things, experience high-speed canoeing, swimming, diving to see corals, fishing, and most exciting is walking on the seabed.

Tourist attractions on Cu Lao Cham Island

Cu Lao Cham welcomes visitors with poetic beaches, pristine natural scenery, long white sand beaches and rich fauna, so let’s take a look at the famous Cu Lao Cham tourist attractions below with Vietlook Travel.

Eo Gio Cu Lao Cham

Located in the east of the island, about 3km from Bai Lang, it is one of the destinations chosen by many tourists, the most beautiful sunset viewing spot on the island.

Ancient well

One of the remaining ancient wells of the Cham people and located in the forbidden residential area, according to the concept of the local people, the well water can cure seasickness and give birth to children as desired. Therefore, this place is increasingly attracting tourists to visit.

Hai Tang Pagoda

The pagoda is located majestically overlooking the vast fields, through many years but until now the pagoda still retains its own beauty, is a sacred destination attracting tourists to come here to worship and sightsee.

Beaches in Cu Lao Cham:

  • Bai Ong
  • Bai Xep
  • Bai Chong
  • Bai Huong

Watching the road of parasol flowers on Cu Lao Cham island, this place is most beautiful from July to August, the season of bright yellow flowers along the route of Bai Lang, Bai Xep, Bai Huong, visitors will be satisfied to admire the beauty of the blooming flowers.

Tan Hiep Market

The market is located at the wharf, visiting the market visitors can buy seafood as gifts, the market has fresh seafood, or dried seafood visitors can buy as gifts, in addition visitors can also buy unique shells, snails, and stones.

The Temple of the Ancestor of the Bird’s Nest Profession

is one of the large-scale architectural works. Every year, a ceremony to honor the Ancestor of the Bird’s Nest Profession is held here on the 10th day of the 3rd lunar month. The solemn ceremony attracts a large number of people and tourists to attend.
